method.driver: Cocos 3.8.8 ordinary automatic frames and native Box2D; controller moveTo/release after 0.18 active seconds in each planning phase. No altered contacts, isStable, scoring, damping, poses or native stepping.
method.timing: Current 1.5-second first-contact handoff remains live. Releases continue even with pending unplaced bodies. After last scheduled release wait at least 3 active seconds, and until true strict stability + all released bodies placed, up to 10 seconds.
method.scope: Eight fixed ten-object actions, same cyclic six-object sequence. This diagnoses bounded control policies, not a human success rate. Ended means the existing calibration whole-body loss rule fired.
method.override: Actual compiled current build; no spec override.
method.supportCentered: Separate adaptive policy, never counted as same-action before/after evidence: target the previous released object local highest horizontal ledge midpoint transformed to world (circle uses center), plus fixed 0 or alternating +/-10 offset. No search, no changing body pose or physics.
